scope: fit: train.h5 only; no val.h5, test.h5 or independent CSV opened
lag_sign: positive L: response(t+L) compared with reference(t); grid resolution 10ms; not absolute sensor latency

units.torque_absolute_calibration: not identifiable: no raw current, independent load-cell, or firmware range readback in these logs
units.hardware_delay: not identifiable: CAN receive times and per-motor last_update are not exported into the recorded state
units.zero_code_note: symmetric uint12 ranges have no exactly zero code; half-LSB is encoding resolution, not proven mechanical motion

noise.definition: scheduled holds trimmed by 1 second at each edge; scatter may include real micro-motion, not pure sensor noise
